Specification: This module is a minimal TLA+ specification used to exercise Type System 1.2 alias syntax rather than to model a transition system or algorithm. The comments explain that a type alias is intentionally missing, so the expected behavior is that an external type checker reports an error. The only top-level operator defines a singleton set from its argument, and there are no state variables, actions, temporal properties, fairness conditions, proofs, or PlusCal constructs.
